This premium cable features MTP‑12 Elite UPC Female connectors on both ends and delivers exceptional signal integrity across 12 fibers‑optimized for short‑range transmission in OM4 multimode environments.With a Type‑B polarity configuration, this cable is ideal for applications like 40G/100G/400G Ethernet, InfiniBand, and Fibre Channel.
